---
title: "Dashboard Crosschecks"
---

If you are signed into the data entry system as "Manager" you will have access to the "Manager Dashboard" button

The dashboard will show the number of entries each diver should have (boatlog entries) and the number of samples (fish, LPI or Demo) each diver has entered.

Clicking on the Crosscheck Boatlog vs. Samples button will show 2 tables.

1) List of samples by diver that have a boatlog entry but **not** a corresponding diver entered sample

2) List of samples entered by diver that do **not** have a corresponding boatlog entry

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Common Issues

1) Boatlogs have a been entered but divers have yet to enter their sample

    - **Fix:** Diver successfully enters sample

2) Date or Field ID is incorrect in either boatlog or diver entry

    - **Fix:** Edit either the boatlog or diver entry.  Editing one or the other typically fixes the issue on both tables
